newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were stable in late trading on Monday amid thin buying interest, traders said.
They said offer prices were unchanged at 49.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan for May/June shipment, at 49.25 fob Surabaya and at 49.00 fob Palembang

Traders offered rubber at 49.00 fob Jambi and at 48.75 fob Pontianak. "There are some bids in the market but traders are reluctant to give up their goods because the prices are too low," said one trader. He said buyers bid at 49.00 in Medan but traders did not want to sell.
Traders said supply was abundant in Indonesia despite wintering in a number of key growing areas.
